This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Gimhae Intl Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 24 Jul '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Gimhae Intl Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/kr/busan/RKPK.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent forecast models from agencies like the Korea Meteorological Administration point to a peak daytime high near 33–34°C in Busan on July 24, driven by a strengthening subtropical ridge delivering clear morning skies and light winds before afternoon monsoon moisture triggers scattered thunderstorms. Coastal sea breezes from the East Sea typically moderate extremes by 1–2°C compared with inland areas, while high humidity and urban heat island effects in the city center can push observed maxima higher if cloud cover remains limited. Model spread on precipitation timing and wind shifts creates the tight clustering around 33–35°C outcomes, with traders weighing historical July averages near 29°C against the current ridge’s influence and potential cooling from any early rain. Updated KMA guidance and ensemble runs over the next 48 hours will likely refine these probabilities.

markets.question: Will the Democratic Party win the TX-14 House seat?
markets.description:
This market will resolve according to the party of the candidate who wins the TX-14 congressional district seat in the U.S. House of Representatives in the 2026 midterm elections. The midterm elections will take place on November 3, 2026.

​A candidate's party will be determined by their ballot-listed or otherwise identifiable affiliation with that party at the time all of the 2026 House elections are conclusively called by this market's resolution sources. A candidate without a ballot-listed affiliation to either the Democrat or Republican parties will be considered a member of one of these parties based on the party with which they most recently expressed their intent to caucus at the time all of the House elections are conclusively called by this market's resolution sources.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the United States government, specifically the Federal Election Commission (https://www.fec.gov/).

Absent such developments, the current market pricing aligns with the district’s established electoral fundamentals and Bishop’s track record.
